name: Game Theory: Five Nights at Freddy's
original_name: Game Theory: Five Nights at Freddy's
overview: Hosted by MatPat, "Game Theory: Five Nights at Freddy's" delves into the lore of the FNAF video game series. Each episode explores mysteries and theories of the game's universe, from Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria's secrets to hidden messages in the games. A perfect mix of entertainment and analysis, it's a must-watch for fans and gamers.
